gloss: overthinking; imagining too much; needless worry

definitions.gloss: overthinking; imagining too much; groundless worry
definitions.explanation: The act of worrying about or reading too much into something that turns out to be nothing. Used to reassure someone (or oneself) that their concerns are unfounded.

examples.japanese: きっと{思|おも}い{過|す}ごしだよ。
examples.english: I'm sure you're just overthinking it.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}い{過|す}ごしかもしれないけど、{彼|かれ}の{態度|たいど}が{気|き}になる。
examples.english: It might just be my imagination, but his attitude bothers me.

examples.japanese: {嫌|きら}われているのかと{心配|しんぱい}していたが、ただの{思|おも}い{過|す}ごしだった。
examples.english: I was worried that they hated me, but it was just my overthinking.

notes:
From {思|おも}う (to think) + {過|す}ごす (to do excessively). Describes the common experience of worrying about something that turns out to be unfounded. Very useful in everyday conversation for reassuring others or dismissing one's own anxieties.

USAGE:
Most commonly used as a predicate: {思|おも}い{過|す}ごしだ / {思|おも}い{過|す}ごしだよ. Also appears with かもしれない when the speaker is unsure: {思|おも}い{過|す}ごしかもしれないけど... (It might just be my imagination, but...).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ただの{思|おも}い{過|す}ごし — just overthinking
- {思|おも}い{過|す}ごしかもしれない — it might just be my imagination
- {思|おも}い{過|す}ごしだといいけど — I hope it's just my overthinking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {気|き}のせい — one's imagination; very similar, slightly more casual
- {考|かんが}えすぎ — overthinking; more direct, focuses on excessive analysis
- {取|と}り{越|こ}し{苦労|くろう} — needless worry; implies worrying about the future unnecessarily
